Just 10 minutes of movement after a meal may help support healthy blood sugar levels. Discover five simple, low-impact exercises you can do at home to help your body manage blood sugar, improve circulation, and stay active throughout the day.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
